name: Beta diversity (PCoA)
description: Between-sample differences from a long taxon profile table: Bray-Curtis (abundance) or Jaccard (presence) distances between samples, a principal coordinates ordination coloured by group, the coordinates as a table, and PERMANOVA (pseudo-F, R2, permutation p) for the group and subject roles.

inputs.label: Taxon profiles (long)
inputs.description: One row per taxon per sample with read counts. Group and subject roles colour the ordination and are tested.

metric.title: Distance
metric.description: Bray-Curtis on relative abundance, or Jaccard on presence and absence.

permutations.title: PERMANOVA permutations
permutations.description: Label permutations for the p-value; 0 skips the test.

rank.title: Taxonomic rank
rank.description: When the table maps a rank role, use taxa of this rank only.

min_reads.title: Minimum reads per sample
min_reads.description: Samples with fewer retained reads are dropped; 0 keeps every sample.

remove_artifacts.title: Remove curated artifacts
remove_artifacts.description: Drop taxa on curation lists with the artifact role before computing distances.

outputs.name: pcoa
outputs.description: Samples on the first two principal coordinates, coloured by group.

outputs.name: pcoa_coordinates
outputs.description: One row per sample: the first three coordinates plus group, subject and timepoint.

outputs.name: permanova
outputs.description: PERMANOVA per factor: groups, pseudo-F, R2, permutation p.

citation: Built with pandas, NumPy, SciPy (Virtanen et al. 2020) and Plotly. PCoA by eigendecomposition of the double-centred squared distances (Gower 1966); PERMANOVA after Anderson (2001), following the INDIVO Explorer ordination page. See README.md for details.
